headline: UN warns nearly 260,000 displaced since August
dek: Fighting intensified in Taiz province between government forces and Ansar Allah. Government spokesperson Majid al-Nazili said government forces launched 835 targeting operations, killing or injuring 285 Ansar Allah members and destroying tanks and weapons stores.
sources: OCHA report (late Nov 4) + Yemeni government military spokesperson, via Al Jazeera
fault_line: Counteroffensive or civilian catastrophe — does 'Dawn of Yemen' liberate Taiz, or is 260,000 displaced the measure of the campaign?
